description: Apply the Library's Virtual Desk boundary to interactive Codex sessions. Events MUST nest under the top-level "hooks" key: Codex accepts only "description" or "hooks" at the root, and rejects the whole file with 'unknown field `PreToolUse`' if an event is placed there. Codex presents Claude-Code-compatible hook payloads: a captured PreToolUse call carries tool_name `Bash` (not `exec`, which appears only in tool_use_id) with tool_input.command as a string, and an MCP tool is `mcp__<server>__<tool>` with the SERVER'S HYPHENS SPELLED AS UNDERSCORES (measured S37 on codex-cli 0.153.4, in the names Codex offers and in a PreToolUse tool_name), so Basic Memory arrives as `mcp__basic_memory__<tool>` and a matcher naming `mcp__basic-memory__` -- which this file carried until S38 -- can never fire. The shell matcher therefore names `Bash`; `exec` is retained only in case a later version exposes the underlying tool id. apply_patch was captured the same way on 2026-09-07 against codex-cli 0.147.0 and is NOT normalised: tool_name is `apply_patch` verbatim, and its tool_input carries no file_path at all -- it reuses the shell tool's `command` field, holding the whole patch document, with every path inside the `*** Add File:` / `*** Update File:` / `*** Delete File:` / `*** Move to:` envelope. One patch can name many files.
